text: いきたい　ばしょに　いけなくて　こまってるのか…　そこから　おもいきって　とびおりて　みろ！

structure.jp: いきたい　ばしょに　いけなくて
structure.en: you can't get to the place you want to go, and so

structure.jp: そこから　おもいきって　とびおりて　みろ！
structure.en: try boldly jumping down from there!

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: みる after a て-form means to try doing something and see what happens. みろ is the blunt order form. とびおりて みろ = 'try jumping down!'

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: いける is the 'can go' form of いく. Here it is in the 'not' form with て, which gives the reason for what follows. いけなくて = 'because you can't go'.

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb means wanting to do it. Here it describes the place that follows. いきたい ばしょ = 'the place you want to go'.
